chunks: He (peace be upon him) said to a man who said in his presence: 'I ask Allah's forgiveness.'

key_terms.أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ: I ask Allah's forgiveness (a form of du'a)
key_terms.إِمَامُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What is the true meaning of istighfar according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) corrects the superficial understanding of *istighfar* by distinguishing between mere verbal recitation and the profound, practical repentance required for spiritual elevation. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on *istighfar* as an active process of self-correction and adherence to divine commandments, rather than a passive ritual. The context underscores the necessity of aligning one's actions with the words of forgiveness to achieve true *ma'rifah* (gnosis).
